ENGLISH

I created 4sylum w4rd as a photorealistic background LoRA depicting a 1960s-70s psychiatric hospital at night. The set builds atmospheric horror through decay, cold fluorescent light and warm amber night lights, without gore. Every scene is designed as an empty stage with a wide open center for placing a character, and every training image is free of people.

The set contains a reception hall, patient corridor, common room, psychiatrist office, patient bedroom, isolation cell, infirmary, hospital laundry, doctor's private room, cafeteria and foggy enclosed grounds.

Use the trigger word 4sylum w4rd at a recommended weight of 0.8-1.0. It is designed for SDXL, Illustrious and Pony workflows, and can also be used with natural-language generators such as Krea.

4sylum w4rd, photorealistic, empty psychiatric hospital corridor at night, faded institutional green walls, dirty off-white tile, cold caged fluorescent lights, warm amber night
